owner_report_2026_11_15_second_journal.statement_summary: the owner said Ketmix is 'more fade transitions than a real automix like Apple Music's', asked for much more research, sent a second journal (three transitions: Filter, Echo, Filter; all 'precise true', 'paths out on, in on') and asked for a new 'Ket 27 (Alpha)' mode giving the app a complete iOS 27 interface.
journal_reading: the 5.4.1 fix held on the device: every transition was precise with both decks' processors in their sound path

none of the three pairs was played in time: 138 into 122 BPM was outside the 8 % range; an ending read at 183 BPM (49 %) belongs to a title whose intro had been read at 122 BPM (3/2 apart); intros read at 21 % confidence gave no usable grid

research.how: two delegated web research passes (search-result excerpts and GitHub sources; most press and Apple pages could not be opened in full)
automix_findings_used: Apple describes AutoMix as time stretching plus beat matching with a fallback to a simple crossfade; iOS 27 reportedly aligns tempo across wider gaps
djay syncs within a few percent and tempo-blends beyond; half/double tempo relations are standard
octave and 3:2 tempo errors are the dominant failure of tempo estimation; reading a drum-bearing section is the usual remedy (inference from sources)
research.ios27_numbers_source: a third-party repository stating it measured Apple's iOS 27 Figma kit; not checked against the kit itself

ketmix_changes: 30 s of the body of each title (from 45 % of its length, titles of 150 s or more, balanced and maximum analysis) are read by the standby deck and stored; intro and ending are analysed against that tempo when the body is confident (>= 45 %), the grid being accepted when the stretch's own attacks give at least 15 % confidence, capped at 60 %
the journal lists the body tempo of each title
owner_report_2026_11_15_second_journal.ket27: see known_limitations: an alpha covering colours, typeface and text styles, settings lists, switch, alerts and the tab bar; other pages inherit colours and type only
never_run_with_real_audio: the body reading and the hinted grids were never run on real music: thresholds (15 %, 45 %, 60 %) are untuned guesses checked on synthetic signals only
blends at 14-18 % tempo difference were never heard; time-stretch artefacts at such ratios are likely on sustained vocals

known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
A Canvas given as a link depends on the site that serves it: if it goes away or refuses streaming, nothing plays behind the title.
Ketmix needs the next title to be playable without a new resolution or one that succeeds in time; otherwise it says so and the title ends as before.
A manual skip is still a plain change of title: it is not mixed.
The mix journal is kept in memory only and is lost when the app is closed.

Ket 27 is an alpha: settings, switch, alerts, tab bar, colours and type follow iOS 27; page layouts elsewhere (Home, Library, album, player, sheets, menus) keep Ketvoice's own structure. No iPad sidebar, no minimised tab bar change, no new haptics.
Titles under 150 s and the light analysis setting get no body reading; 3:2 and 4:3 tempo relations between two different titles are still not mixed in time.
Reading the body of two titles adds about 5 to 10 seconds of silent decoding before each new pair.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
